sources.rules: Repository tools/card-frames/rules-001-020.json and source-card images; checked against user-supplied Expanded CRD. No card-specific overrides for #1–5.

sources.artwork: Published card artwork from source commit, cropped without repainting or stretching. Display source is 1060x1484; downloaded artwork remains raster at original resolution.
